title.en: Table 9 — Classification of corrected QT interval prolongation induced by cancer drug therapy

text.en: High risk: QTcF prolongation ≥ 10 ms and risk of TdP
text.ru: Высокий риск: удлинение QTcF ≥ 10 мс и риск развития TdP

text.en:

• Arsenic trioxide
• Glasdegib
• Nilotinib
• Oxaliplatin
• Pazopanib
• Ribociclib

text.en: Low risk: QTcF prolongation < 10 ms (ADT may prolong QTc: GnRH agonists/antagonists, bicalutamide, flutamide, apalutamide, darolutamide, enzalutamide, abiraterone)
